subject: Commit phasing playbook — GPU/TPM onramp & term discount options
messages:

Subject: Dedicated onramp — looking for staged prepay options

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — AtlasAI is excited about Redwood's latency profiles. Procurement asked me to surface a few things we need to evaluate before we move to a PO:

- Multi-year pricing with an annual prepay option (we'd prefer to prepay annually rather than a single lump sum)
- A phased GPU / TPM onramp so we don't pay for full capacity upfront
- Term discount structure and whether discounts can be blended across years

Can you share an example schedule or playbook for a staged dedicated commitment (e.g., Q1 16 GPUs, Q2 +24 GPUs etc.), and the corresponding discounts for 1/2/3-year commitments? I've attached our PO template.

Appreciate a concise set of options so procurement and finance can run the math.

Subject: Re: Dedicated onramp — looking for staged prepay options

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — looped in Marissa (AE) and Karthik (pricing) so we can give you a compact playbook. Attached is a short PDF with three pragmatic options (summary below).

Attachment: redwood_commit_phasing_playbook_v2.pdf

Quick summary (numbers example, final pricing depends on model mix and average TPM):

Option A — 12-month ramp (annual prepay)
- Year 1 prepaid at start: 40% of committed capacity, month-by-month ramp to 100% by month 6
- Effective term discount: 12% on list unit rates for 1-year annual prepay
- Benefit: predictable monthly throughput, smallest up-front cash compared to full prepay

Option B — 24-month blended (annual prepay each year)
- Year 1: prepay 50% capacity; Year 2: prepay remaining 50% at renewal
- Effective blended discount: 18% first year, 22% second year when fully committed (we can protect year-1 pricing for year-2 after signature)
- Benefit: lower blended $/token over two years; step-in credits if you accelerate ramp

Option C — 36-month staircase (annual prepay with committed tranches)
- Annual prepay with discrete tranches (e.g., 25% / 35% / 40% over three years)
- Effective discount: 24% at full-term; additional onboarding credits available for >24 month commits

Key commercial flex we can offer:
- Smoothing: allow you to allocate prepaid dollars to capacity above the tranche for short bursts (billing reconciliation quarterly)
- Acceleration credits: if you bring ramp forward we convert unused tranches into usage credits rather than refunds
- Early opt-out: limited termination rights after 12 months with a step-down fee (we can model)

Ask: can you confirm the shape you prefer (fast ramp vs. smoothing-first) and whether AtlasAI requires annual invoicing cadence vs single invoice? Once we have the preference we will send a table with concrete GPU/TPM counts and per-unit rates.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Dedicated Platforms
Redwood Inference

Vivek,

Thanks for the detailed options — the playbook PDF was helpful. A couple of clarifications from procurement and finance:

1) Atlas prefers annual prepay invoices (one invoice per year). Will Redwood accept annual invoices tied to year-of-service rather than a single initial invoice?
2) We'd favor Option B (24-month blended) but want a smoothing mechanism: start at ~30% capacity for first 3 months, then 60% for months 4-9, and reach 100% by month 12. Can you price that cadence?
3) Termination language: procurement won't accept unlimited early termination exposure. Can you propose a clear step-down schedule or buyout that caps downside?

I've attached our PO template again and flagged the clauses procurement will redline — primarily termination and invoicing cadence.

Appreciate if Marissa / Karthik can propose a one-page commercial term sheet reflecting the smoothing cadence + blended discount for year 1 & 2.

Best,
Sofia

Subject: Re: Dedicated onramp — looking for staged prepay options

Hi Sofia —

Per Vivek and Karthik's input, attached is a concise commercial term sheet that maps your requested smoothing cadence to a blended 24-month price. Highlights below (numbers illustrative and finalized after model mix):

- Structure: 24-month commitment, annual invoicing (we will issue invoice at start of each 12-month year)
- Year 1 cadence (example GPU counts): months 1-3 = 30% (48 GPU-hrs/day equiv), months 4-9 = 60%, months 10-12 = 85%
- Year 2 cadence: targets 100% capacity with a 60-day acceleration window (you can accelerate earlier and get acceleration credits applied to year-2 invoice)
- Pricing: blended discount of 20% for year 1 (applies to prepaid units), 22% for year 2 once fully ramped; final per-unit TPM and token thresholds in attached term sheet
- Termination: Mutual termination after month 12 with a defined buyout equal to remaining prepaid months at 70% credit value; no capless exposure
- Acceleration credits: any prepaid but unused tranche can be converted into a usage credit for other Redwood services within the account up to 12 months of issue

Attachment: redwood_commit_phasing_playbook_v2.pdf (updated term sheet section)

Next steps: if this aligns, we can prepare a draft SOW + DocuSign package tied to AtlasAI's PO. Would you like us to preserve the specific contract language around invoicing and termination in the SOW or in the Master Services Agreement?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
